identity.title: A Magnified View of Circumnuclear Star Formation and Feedback around an Active Galactic Nucleus at z = 2.6

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this work we present new observations of 9io9 with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) to study the resolved properties of molecular gas in the galaxy across a range of densities.

method.value: Redshift from mid-point of fwzi of continuum-subtracted lines; fluxes summed in >=3 sigma region over |dV|<500 km/s; uncertainties by 1000 noise realisations

evidence.quote: By repeating this process 1000 times we asses the standard deviation in $\int S_\nu dV$ and derived luminosity, which we take as the 1$\sigma$ uncertainty.

method.value: Semi-linear inversion with power-law primary lens, SIS companion, external shear, Bayesian evidence, MCMC on CO(4-3) integrated map, random Voronoi source pixelization; source-plane cube per channel

evidence.quote: The set of parameters is optimized using the Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method (Suyu et al. 2006)

assumptions.value: Both lenses at same redshift for M/L ratio

evidence.quote: assuming that both lie at the same redshift

fitting.value: MCMC, best fit by Bayesian evidence

evidence.quote: until the global best fit has been obtained according to the Bayesian evidence (Suyu et al. 2006)

method.value: galpak3d ring/disk model on source-plane CO(4-3) cube after PSF homogenisation (135 mas kernel); tanh rotation curve; 1000 chains of up to 5000 iterations with 10% perturbed starts

evidence.quote: run 1000 independent chains, each with a maximum of 5000 iterations
As in previous works, we fix $\alpha=0$

fitting.value: Median of converged parameters, 16th/84th percentiles as uncertainty

evidence.quote: We take the 50th percentile of the converged parameters over the 1000 chains as the final estimate
with a median reduced $\chi^2=1.08$
we assume a Ci/H$_2$ abundance $X_{\rm CI}=3\times10^{-5}$ and excitation $Q_{10}=0.5$

findings_qualitative.value: CN(4-3)/HNC blend is compact (~80% unresolved, <360 pc) and much broader than the ring, possibly a dense molecular outflow or SF-driven wind

evidence.quote: with approximately 80% of the integrated flux unresolved, corresponding to emission on scales below 360 pc

claims.hypothesis: Is the molecular gas arranged in a resolved rotating ring?
claims.experiment: Lens-model source-plane reconstruction and galpak3d fit of CO(4-3)
claims.result: Ring Rmax~2.6 kpc, Vmax=360 km/s, i=50 deg
claims.finding: A 2.5 kpc radius molecular ring is resolved

evidence.quote: we resolve a 2.5 kpc-radius ring of star-forming molecular gas

claims.hypothesis: Is there a dynamically distinct dense gas component near the AGN?
claims.finding: Possible dense outflow/interaction with AGN, but not unambiguous

evidence.quote: we cannot unambiguously distinguish between an AGN versus ‘star formation’ origin of the CN$(N=4\rightarrow 3)$ emission

claims.hypothesis: Can AGN feedback quench star formation in the ring?
claims.finding: Feedback unlikely to curtail stellar mass assembly in ring

evidence.quote: AGN feedback will do little to curtail the ongoing rapid stellar mass assembly in the surrounding ring

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Fixing HNC/CN width to ring dispersion 73 km/s gives no sensible fit

evidence.quote: does not result in a sensible fit to the data

limitations_admitted.value: Deblending of HNC/CN depends strongly on redshift; outflow rate cannot be estimated; limited tracers

evidence.quote: deeper observations will be required to properly model the complex

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas mass relies on assumed X_CI and Q10 with no uncertainty on them
SFR relies on assumed epsilon and f_d/t
Outflow interpretation rests on a blended line with redshift-dependent decomposition
Lens model uncertainties not propagated into ring parameters
